description: 25 questions over the 10-document parser evaluation sample. Every answer was verified against the source page itself: the PDF text layer for born-digital pages, the rendered page image for scanned pages and charts. Page numbers are 1-based pages of the original PDF.

difficulty_levels.easy: The answer is plain text on the page. Any extraction that keeps the words is enough; no layout knowledge needed.
difficulty_levels.medium: The answer is a cell of one table or chart: the parse must keep row label and column header (period) together with the value.
difficulty_levels.hard: Needs context beyond the cell: which statement (standalone vs consolidated), unit, speaker attribution, chart value-to-period mapping, a page whose text layer is wrong, or combining two pages/documents.

must_contain_note: Strings the evidence pages' extracted text must contain for the answer to be recoverable. Matching ignores case, whitespace and thousands separators. Presence is necessary, not sufficient: it does not prove the value is attached to the right row/column (check that with the pack's per-page checks or a QA step).
